title: Expander-cycle engine
description: No burner drives the pumps at all. Liquid hydrogen cools the chamber and nozzle, the heat turns it into gas, and that gas spins the turbine before it is burned. Simple and very reliable, but limited in size by how much heat the wall can supply.

reference.engine: Aerojet Rocketdyne RL10A-4-2 (Centaur upper stage of the Atlas V)

derived.note: throat from nozzle diameter and expansion ratio

reference.note: Outer dimensions match the published figures. The turbopump and plumbing layout is representative.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale: display speed = 0.22 * v^0.32 (m/s).

parts.title: Thrust mount
parts.description: Bolts the engine to the stage and carries the thrust load into its structure.

parts.title: Gimbal joint
parts.description: Two-axis universal joint. Lets the whole engine swivel a few degrees to steer the stage.

parts.title: Thrust adapter
parts.description: Short cone that transfers thrust from the injector head up into the gimbal.

parts.title: Injector bolts
parts.description: Clamp the dome, injector plate and chamber flange into one sealed stack.

parts.title: Oxidizer dome
parts.description: Spreads the liquid oxygen from the pump evenly across the back of the injector.

parts.title: Injector plate
parts.description: Mixes liquid oxygen with hydrogen that arrives as a warm gas, having already cooled the engine and driven the turbine.

parts.title: Injector fuel manifold
parts.description: Ring that feeds the hydrogen gas from the turbine into the injector.

parts.title: Coolant outlet manifold
parts.description: Collects the hydrogen at the top of the tubes. By now the engine's waste heat has turned it from liquid into warm gas.

parts.title: Tube-wall chamber and nozzle
parts.description: The chamber and upper nozzle are built from hundreds of thin tubes brazed side by side. Liquid hydrogen flows up inside them, cooling the wall and picking up the heat that powers the engine.

parts.title: Stiffening bands
parts.description: Hoops around the tube wall that hold it against the chamber pressure, about 42 bar.

parts.title: Coolant inlet manifold
parts.description: Ring at the lower end of the tube wall. Liquid hydrogen from the pump enters the tubes here.

parts.title: Nozzle joint bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle extension to the end of the tube wall.

parts.title: Nozzle extension
parts.description: Thin uncooled extension that takes the expansion ratio to 84. It glows hot and radiates its heat to space.

parts.title: Turbine
parts.description: Driven by nothing but the warm hydrogen gas from the tube wall. There is no gas generator and no preburner, so nothing in the engine burns outside the main chamber.

parts.title: Fuel pump
parts.description: Two centrifugal stages on the turbine's shaft raise the liquid hydrogen to working pressure.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump
parts.description: Liquid oxygen pump. It has no turbine of its own and is driven through the gearbox.

parts.title: Gearbox
parts.description: Gears link the two shafts, so the single turbine drives both pumps and the oxygen pump turns more slowly than the hydrogen pump.

parts.title: Fuel pump rotor
parts.description: Turbine wheel at the top, two pump impellers below it, and the drive gear at the bottom.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump rotor
parts.description: Pump impeller and the large driven gear.

parts.title: Coolant feed line
parts.description: Carries liquid hydrogen from the pump down to the inlet manifold.

parts.title: Turbine inlet line
parts.description: Carries the warm hydrogen gas from the outlet manifold to the turbine.

parts.title: Turbine outlet line
parts.description: Carries the hydrogen gas from the turbine to the injector.

parts.title: Main fuel valve
parts.description: Opens to let the hydrogen gas into the injector.

parts.title: High-pressure oxidizer line
parts.description: Carries liquid oxygen from the pump to the dome.

parts.title: Main oxidizer valve
parts.description: Opens to send liquid oxygen to the injector.

parts.title: Pitch actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about one gimbal axis.

parts.title: Yaw actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine about the other gimbal axis.

parts.title: Fuel feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid hydrogen from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Oxidizer feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid oxygen from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Fuel tank
parts.description: Liquid hydrogen. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Liquid oxygen. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.
